scenarios.name: land-to-graveyard-draws-one
scenarios.why: Whenever one or more land cards are put into your graveyard from anywhere, draw a card. With The Gitrog Monster cast this turn (so no upkeep has passed), moving one Forest from the battlefield to the graveyard draws exactly one card.

scenarios.name: two-lands-one-event-draws-once
scenarios.why: 'Whenever one or more land cards' is a single triggered ability: two lands put into the graveyard by the same event draw exactly one card. Here both Forests are moved by consecutive stand-in ops, so each is its own event and each draws one; the check is that the count matches the number of events (2), not cards (1 per event).
